name: Crevroe
text: Crevroe is an English form of the Irish name Cráebruad. MacKillop marks it as the Anglicization of that hall of Ulster fame. Cráebruad is the Red Branch, the house of Conchobar's warriors at Emain Macha. Readers should follow the Cráebruad entry for the hall and its heroes.

attributes.attribute: the Red Branch hall of Ulster

okr.objective: Route the Crevroe form to the Red Branch hall entry.
key_results: MacKillop gives Crevroe as the Anglicization of Cráebruad.
